protocol_steps.action: Verify frozen_design.json hashes match files received
protocol_steps.pass_criterion: All SHA-256 hashes match. If any mismatch, STOP and contact package owner.

protocol_steps.action: Reproduce simulator results on lab's own machine
protocol_steps.pass_criterion: Lab's results match our pre-registered results within +/- 5% on all metrics. If not, lab's Python environment differs from ours — investigate before proceeding.
All reproducibility checks pass before formal validation begins.

protocol_steps.action: Run formal validation: 6 scenarios × 5 seeds = 30 bench runs

protocol_steps.format: JSON file with per-run metrics, uploaded to shared repository

protocol_steps.action: Independent analysis: lab computes whether pre-registered acceptance criteria (08_acceptance_criteria.json) are met
protocol_steps.rule: Lab does NOT consult package owner during analysis. Results are reported as PASS/FAIL against each AC.

blinding: See blind_evaluation.md for blinding protocol. Lab should not know which seed produced which result until after analysis is complete.
